title: SALT cap, married filing separately 2026, AGI exactly at the phase-down start ($252,500)
note: No cut yet: the whole-return limit $40,400 is halved for a separate return: $20,200.

title: SALT cap, married filing separately 2026, AGI $100,000 over the phase-down start
note: Excess over the halved threshold $252,500 is $100,000. The cut comes first: $40,400 - 30% x $100,000 = $10,400 (above the $10,000 floor); the halving comes after: $5,200. The old code halved first and then took 30%: $20,200 - $30,000, floored at $5,000.
